acceptedAnswer.text: The TTC is a full 40-day intensive course comprising 200 hours of structured learning, daily practice, and teaching methodology.

There are three participation/residential options to fit your needs: Seeker (non-residential for local students), Immersive (comfortable 1 BHK stay, food, and local transit at CSE Residences), and Ultimate (complete sanctuary living at Purantha).

mainEntity.name: What is included in the Seeker (₹1.75 lakh) option?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Seeker (₹1.75 Lakh INR) option includes 40 days of training, all TTC materials, 2 diet/health consultations, 6-month DYC access, 3 Ayurveda therapy sessions at Purantha, special training sessions at Purantha, 6 months Awaken Tribe membership, and 3-day Purantha Camp access. Stay, food, and travel are not included.

mainEntity.name: What is included in the Immersive (₹3.5 lakh) option?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Immersive (₹3.5 Lakh INR) option includes 40 days training, TTC materials, 1 BHK accommodation at CSE Residences, food, travel, 6 months DYC access, 6 months Awaken Tribe membership, Purantha experiences, and 3-day Purantha Camp access.

mainEntity.name: What is included in the Ultimate (₹5 lakh) option?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Ultimate (₹5 Lakh INR) option is our premier sanctuary immersion tier. It includes 40 days training, full Purantha campus access, 3 Ayurveda sessions, 2 medicinal showers, 2 tissue healing sessions (subject to expert recommendation), pure Sattvik food, 1 year of Awaken Tribe and DYC access, and 3-day Purantha Camp access.

mainEntity.name: Do I need previous yoga experience?

acceptedAnswer.text: No prior advanced experience is required. The curriculum begins with foundational alignment and anatomy, making it ideal for both dedicated beginners seeking deep immersion and experienced practitioners preparing to teach professionally.

Upon successful practical and theoretical completion of the 40 days (200 hours), you receive the official Akshar Yoga Basic Level Yoga Teacher Certificate, recognized across the global Akshar Yoga ecosystem.
Food is fully included in the Immersive (₹3.5L) and Ultimate (₹5L) options. For the Seeker (₹1.75L) tier, meals and accommodation are not included.

Yes, accommodation is included in the Immersive option (1 BHK stay at CSE Residences) and the Ultimate option (full campus sanctuary at Purantha). For the Seeker option, students arrange their own stay in Bangalore.
